title: San Lorenzo takes the field to face Estudiantes
seoTitle: San Lorenzo Faces Estudiantes in Torneo Clausura 2026
subtitle: El Ciclón visits the Antonio Candini stadium in search of a winning streak.
excerpt: San Lorenzo prepares to face Estudiantes de Río Cuarto for the Torneo Clausura 2026 in a match with restrictions for away fans.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
San Lorenzo de Almagro takes the field to face Estudiantes de Río Cuarto in a match valid for the sixth matchday of the Torneo Clausura 2026. The clash takes place at the Antonio Candini stadium and excites fans due to the teams' current standing in the competition.

Teams' situation in the standings

San Lorenzo arrives for the clash led by coach Néstor Gorosito after defeating Unión de Santa Fe 1-0, with a goal by Rodrigo Auzmendi. The result allowed the team to breathe in the competition following their previous defeat against Huracán. Now, Ciclón's goal is to manage to string together two consecutive victories in the championship.

Estudiantes' planning

On the other side, Estudiantes de Río Cuarto is managed by Rubén "Yagui" Forestello. The team aims to reverse its recent results and counts on the support of its home fans to try to surprise the heavyweight rival.

Security scheme and public restrictions

The local government informed that traffic cuts in the vicinity of the stadium begin at 7 PM. The board's efforts to have away fans did not succeed, therefore the stadium will be exclusively for the home supporters, with entry prohibited for people domiciled in the Autonomous City of Buenos Aires and a restriction on wearing rival club jerseys.

Probable line-ups for the duel

Estudiantes is expected to take the field with Lucas Bruera; Gonzalo González, Gonzalo Maffini, Sergio Ojeda, Matías Valenti, Fernando Rodríguez, Tomás González, Francisco Romero, Gabriel Alanís, Ibrahim Hesar, and Yeison Moreno. The visiting team should line up with José Devecchi; Danilo Arboleda, Teo Rodríguez, Emiliano Amor, Nicolás Blanco, Ignacio Perruzzi, Juan Pablo Álvarez, Nicolás Tripichio, Alexis Cuello, Matías Reali, and Rodrigo Auzmendi. The refereeing features Nazareno Arasa with the whistle and Lucas Cavallero on VAR.

With information from puntal.com.ar.
